What's new in 2.33.1

A fix for connecting Herdr to a server with a key file.

A downloaded key file just works now

  • Dax narrows your key's permissions for you. A .pem downloaded from AWS, or from any cloud console, arrives readable by everyone on the Mac — and ssh refuses to use a private key in that state. Dax now tightens it to owner-only before connecting, so the key you just downloaded works on the first try.
  • And when it can't, it says so properly. The old failure was Permission denied (publickey), which reads as the server turning your key down when the key never left your Mac. A key Dax isn't allowed to touch now names the file and the one command that fixes it.

Also in this release

  • Signed, notarized, universal (Apple Silicon & Intel), macOS 14+.
